description: This file handles the queuing of emails related to a specific campaign in SuiteCRM. It retrieves the relevant prospect lists, extracts prospect, contact, or lead IDs, prepares email objects, and queues them for sending by saving email records in the database. It also performs a redirect after processing.

classes.name: EmailQueue
classes.description: Handles the queuing of email messages for campaign prospects, contacts, and leads in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: retrieveProspectAndQueueEmails
methods.description: Retrieves prospect list members for a campaign and queues emails for each contact, prospect, or lead.
